info.name: Box Authorize Authorization File Versions API

query.description:
A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the
response. This can be used to request fields that are
not normally returned in a standard response.

Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the
effect that none of the standard fields are returned in
the response unless explicitly specified, instead only
fields for the mini representation are returned, additional
to the fields requested.

variable.description:
(Required) The unique identifier that represents a file.

The ID for any file can be determined
by visiting a file in the web application
and copying the ID from the URL. For example,
for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123`
the `file_id` is `123`.
(Required) The ID of the file version

request.description:
Retrieve a specific version of a file.

Versions are only tracked for Box users with premium accounts.

response.name:
Returns a specific version of a file.

Not all available fields are returned by default. Use the
[fields](#param-fields) query parameter to explicitly request
any specific fields.

header.description:
Ensures this item hasn't recently changed before
making changes.

Pass in the item's last observed `etag` value
into this header and the endpoint will fail
with a `412 Precondition Failed` if it
has changed since.

request.description:
Restores a specific version of a file after it was deleted.
Don't use this endpoint to restore Box Notes,
as it works with file formats such as PDF, DOC,
PPTX or similar.

response.name: Returns a restored file version object.

request.description:
Promote a specific version of a file.

If previous versions exist, this method can be used to
promote one of the older versions to the top of the version history.

This creates a new copy of the old version and puts it at the
top of the versions history. The file will have the exact same contents
as the older version, with the the same hash digest, `etag`, and
name as the original.

Other properties such as comments do not get updated to their
former values.

Don't use this endpoint to restore Box Notes,
as it works with file formats such as PDF, DOC,
PPTX or similar.

response.name: Returns a newly created file version object.

request.description:
Retrieve a list of the past versions for a file.

Versions are only tracked by Box users with premium accounts. To fetch the ID
of the current version of a file, use the `GET /file/:id` API.
